subject: Merchant-of-Record, jurisdiction & SKU classification for CloudBridge listing
messages:
From: Elena Marino <elena@cloudbridge.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: partners-ops@bigcloud.com, samir.kapoor@integrators.io
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Merchant-of-Record, SKU mapping and jurisdiction notes for CloudBridge listing

Hi Vivek / team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As we move to list CloudBridge on BigCloud's marketplace with Redwood as the runtime provider, Marketplace Ops asked us to confirm Merchant-of-Record (MOR) responsibilities and how SKUs will be classified for metered billing. A few items we need answered this week so we can finish the listing intake:

- Will Redwood act as MOR for US customers, EU customers, or both? BigCloud needs a single MOR for each billing jurisdiction.
- For metered token SKUs: are you planning per-token billing (metered) or bundled fixed-hour SKUs for offer packages? This affects how we present pricing in the catalog.
- Chargebacks and refunds: if Redwood is MOR in a region, can Redwood accept liability for chargebacks for that jurisdiction? Any constraints we should know about?
- Compliance evidence: Marketplace Ops requested SOC2 and an audited billing walkthrough for Redwood invoices. Attached is our proposed SKU draft (morp_sku_matrix.xlsx) and a short note on regional tax implications.

Deadline: BigCloud's intake board is meeting on Tuesday 2026-08-18 — can you reply with a point-of-contact for finance and legal plus an initial position on MOR by COB Monday 8/17?

Thanks,
Elena Marino
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBridge AI

Attachments referenced: morp_sku_matrix.xlsx (draft SKU map), regional-tax-requirements.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marino <elena@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, partners-ops@bigcloud.com
Date: 2026-08-14T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Merchant-of-Record, SKU mapping and jurisdiction notes for CloudBridge listing

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick internal routing so responses are actionable: Ben (Finance) will validate MOR billing mechanics and tax exposure, Olga (Legal) will review liability and addendum language, Karthik (Marketplace Eng) will confirm SKU tagging for metered vs fixed offers.

High-level answers (we'll follow up with specifics):
1) MOR scope: Redwood can act as MOR for the US by default; for the EU we prefer partner-managed MOR to avoid EU VAT registration where possible. We need confirmation from BigCloud on multi-jurisdiction MOR policies.
2) SKU model: default recommendation is metered per-token SKUs for the raw inference API + optional fixed bundle SKUs for enterprise packages. We can publish both variants but need to map which catalog SKU is canonical for billing.
3) Chargebacks: Redwood can accept chargeback risk in the US if Finance signs off; will need a cap/indemnity in the MOR addendum.

Action items:
- Ben: please prepare an initial MOR exposure note for US vs EU (tax, chargeback risk) by EOD Monday 8/17.
- Olga: draft a short MOR addendum template & highlight any legal blockers for accepting chargebacks.
- Karthik: review the attached SKU matrix and flag tags that BigCloud will need for metering ingestion.

Propose a 30-minute sync with Marketplace Ops and BigCloud on Tuesday 8/18 at 10:30 PT to align on MOR mapping before the intake vote. If that works for you, Elena, please send a calendar invite.

I'll pull together an internal checklist and attach it to the MAM (mutual action plan).

— Vivek
GM, Alliances & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Internal attachments to follow: mor_reqs_checklist.pdf (internal)
From: Elena Marino <elena@cloudbridge.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, partners-ops@bigcloud.com
Date: 2026-08-14T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Merchant-of-Record, SKU mapping and jurisdiction notes for CloudBridge listing

Thanks Vivek — that timeline works. A few clarifications from Marketplace Ops:

- BigCloud requires a named MOR for each billing block. For the initial listing they prefer the seller-of-record for the country of the buyer — if Redwood will be MOR in the US we can proceed, but BigCloud will require a MOR addendum attached to the listing (DocuSign link below). For EU buyers the preference is partner-as-MOR unless Redwood has EU tax registration.
- For the metered SKU ingestion: BigCloud's ingestion pipeline needs a canonical sku_id for each billing model and a meter_type field (token, request, seat). Karthik — I'll share the ingestion spec in the invite.
- Chargebacks: BigCloud enforces a 60-day dispute window; if Redwood accepts MOR in the US you will be the primary contract holder for disputes. We can discuss a pass-through indemnity for non-billing fraud cases.

I'll send the DocuSign MOR addendum and the ingestion spec immediately after this email. Calendar invite for Tue 8/18 10:30 PT is sent.

Elena
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBridge AI

Links: MOR addendum DocuSign — https://docusign.com/tx/9a8b7c-mor-addendum ; Ingestion spec drive — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/marketplace-ingest-spec
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marino <elena@cloudbridge.ai>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, partners-ops@bigcloud.com
Date: 2026-08-16T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Merchant-of-Record, SKU mapping and jurisdiction notes for CloudBridge listing

Team — quick status after internal review and the Tuesday sync:

1) Finance position: Redwood will accept MOR for US listings with the following constraints — (a) chargeback exposure capped to the transactional volume for the prior 12 months for that account; (b) Redwood requires Marketplace Ops to route dispute evidence requests to redwood-billing@redwood.com within 10 business days.
2) Tax/Compliance: For EU we recommend partner-as-MOR unless we register VAT in specific member states; that is a 4–6 week runway if required.
3) SKU tagging: Karthik will convert the attached morp_sku_matrix.xlsx into BigCloud's ingestion format (sku_id, meter_type, price_per_unit) and share by EOD 8/17.

Next steps / owners:
- Olga to draft MOR addendum comments and finalize indemnity language (owner: olga_petrov) — due 8/19.
- Karthik to produce ingestion-formatted SKU file (owner: karthik_iyer) — due 8/17.
- Finance to produce chargeback exposure note and operational contacts (owner: ben_carter) — done (see attached audited-evidence.pdf).

Elena — once Olga signs off on the addendum, we'll countersign the DocuSign link. Thanks for moving quickly on the intake board.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: morp_sku_matrix.xlsx (from CloudBridge), audited-evidence.pdf (Redwood billing walkthrough)
